thread:
incident-bot: Pager opened: SEV2 - elevated error rate and quality regression detected for model 'redwood-chat-3' in eu-west1. Alert: hallucination_rate > 6% (threshold 1.5%).
Aisha (oncall): saw it. Canary to prod rolled ~08:02 UTC.
Tom (eng): looking. grabbing logs from canary nodes now.
Carlos (sre): traffic shift? autoscale behaved normal. No infra CPU/GPU spikes.
Priya (ml): initial eval on canary outputs shows consistent prompt-tokenization mismatch — some tokens being split differently after the tokenizer update. This explains weird completions and longer outputs.
Aisha (oncall): top priority: stop further canary -> full rollout. Which rollback option is safest?
Tom (eng): recommend immediate canary rollback to v2-quantized (compatible tokenizer) and pin users who hit errors. Command: ```redwoodctl models rollback --model redwood-chat-3 --to v2-quantized --region eu-west1 --force```
Nikhil (prodops): executing rollback now. Pushing traffic back to v2-quantized and pinning pinned_variants for affected customer orgs.
incident-bot: action started: rollback job 0x7f3a queued by Nikhil.
Priya (ml): also suggest temporary runtime heuristic: truncate continuation if token length > +50% expected, to mitigate runaway outputs until tokenizer patch lands. Can put as request-level policy in routing.
Carlos (sre): applied rate-limit/response-size guard to the eu-west1 gateway. 
Aisha (oncall): customer impact assessment — which customers saw degraded outputs? Need list for comms.
Nikhil (prodops): patching logs to surface `model_variant` and `tokenizer_hash` for last 6h. Pulling customer hits with error_score >= 0.6 now.
Tom (eng): root cause summary: tokenizer packaging change in v3 introduced different byte splitting for non-ascii sequences. Model weights were fine but tokenization differences caused context shifts -> hallucination spike. Fix will be to repackage tokenizer and add compatibility test.
Priya (ml): ML action items: 1) revert tokenizer bundle 2) add tokenizer-compat eval to CI (test with language distribution + emojis + CJK) 3) re-run regression suite.
Aisha (oncall): drafting status page + customer note. Sharing internal and public text below. Please tag edits.
Priya (ml): +1 to public transparency, but avoid technical overload. Mention rollback and mitigation done, ETA for full fix?
Tom (eng): ETA for full fix: ~6 hours to validate tokenizer packaging, +2h for canary then roll out.
Carlos (sre): monitoring metrics: hallucination_rate, avg tokens per response, P95 latency. Will watch for regression.
Aisha (oncall): INTERNAL STATUS (for internal channel):
```
Summary: Canary rollout of redwood-chat-3 introduced tokenizer mismatch leading to increased hallucinations and oversized responses in eu-west1. We rolled back canary -> v2-quantized at 08:15 UTC. Mitigations applied: response-size guard, temporary truncation heuristic, pinned affected customers to v2-quantized.
Impact: Some customers received lower-quality completions and increased token usage; no infra instability. Severity: SEV2.
Next steps: patch tokenizer bundle (Priya), add CI tests (Priya+Tom), canary re-deploy after verification (~6-8h), update customers.
Owner: Aisha (oncall) until 09:00 UTC then handoff to Tom (eng).
```
Aisha (oncall): PUBLIC STATUS (status.redwood.ai):
```
We detected an issue impacting a small subset of requests to the "redwood-chat-3" model in eu-west1 after a recent canary deploy. We have rolled back to the previous validated variant and applied temporary safeguards to limit affected outputs. Customers in the impacted region should see normal behavior now. We are investigating the root cause and expect a validated fix and careful redeploy within the next 8 hours. We will update this page as we make progress.
```
Priya (ml): CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT (short):
```
Subject: Incident: temporary model quality regression in eu-west1 — update
Hi —
We identified a regression for a subset of requests using redwood-chat-3 in eu-west1 after a canary deploy. We rolled back to the prior validated variant and applied protections. Most customers should see normal service now. If you notice degraded outputs, please reply and include a sample (we keep logs for 6h). We expect a full fix and redeploy within 8 hours.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```
Nikhil (prodops): sent targeted notices to customers with hits > threshold; ops@sales notified for high-value accounts.
Tom (eng): running a quick CI patch for tokenizer packaging now. Will open PR with test vectors.
Carlos (sre): monitoring dashboards updated. Will page if hallucination_rate > 2% post-rollback.
Aisha (oncall): handoff: I need to step off at 09:00 UTC. Tom, you'll take primary ownership of the incident after that. Please confirm.
Tom (eng): I accept handoff. I'll post a follow-up summary at 10:00 UTC and coordinate the canary re-deploy once tests pass.
Priya (ml): leaving note: if we re-deploy, add an extra canary traffic slice with tokenization-compat tests enabled and synthetic input set (CJK, emojis, punctuation-heavy).
Aisha (oncall): thanks team :heart: — closing this pager thread after docs + email send.
incident-bot: Pager resolved by rollback and mitigations. Resolution code: ROLLBACK_TOKENIZER_compat.
Tom (eng): postmortem ticket created: INF-4281 (assign: Priya/Tom/Carlos). Please add any missed details there.
